title: PowerFactory / Solver CSV Cleaner
description: Upload a solver-output CSV (PowerFactory, PSS/E, Python script). Drop blank rows, choose which columns to keep, set decimal precision, and download a clean XLSX (with column widths and number formats) or a clean CSV.

blocks.text: Designed for the typical workflow: solver dumps a wide CSV with many columns and blank trailing rows; you only want a handful of those columns in the report appendix. This skips the paste-special / text-to-columns / format-cells dance.
All processing is local — files never leave your browser. Safe for client-confidential data.
